content.text: PyMuPDF 2.0 包太大，改用轻量旧版来转。

input.command:
kill 9108 2>/dev/null
# also kill pip children
pkill -f "pip install pymupdf" 2>/dev/null
sleep 1
VENV="/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/tmp/pdf2html/.venv"
"$VENV/bin/pip" install 'pymupdf==1.25.5' 2>&1

VENV="/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/tmp/pdf2html/.venv"
PDF="/Users/mac/.cursor/projects/Users-mac-Desktop-CHcode/attachments/dd6c1cc2-e1cf-4075-ba05-0d9b371556de/10___________________.pdf"
OUTDIR="/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/tmp/pdf2html"
"$VENV/bin/python" - <<'PY'
import fitz, json, html, re
from pathlib import Path

pdf = Path("/Users/mac/.cursor/projects/Users-mac-Desktop-CHcode/attachments/dd6c1cc2-e1cf-4075-ba05-0d9b371556de/10___________________.pdf")
outdir = Path("/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/tmp/pdf2html")
doc = fitz.open(pdf)
print("pages", doc.page_count)
print("metadata", doc.metadata)
page = doc[0]
print("size", page.rect)
text = page.get_text("text")
print("---TEXT---")
print(text)
print("---END TEXT len", len(text), "---")
# also try html output from pymupdf
html_out = page.get_text("html")
(outdir / "page0_raw.html").write_text(html_out, encoding="utf-8")
print("raw html bytes", len(html_out))
# xhtml
xhtml = page.get_text("xhtml")
(outdir / "page0_xhtml.html").write_text(xhtml, encoding="utf-8")
print("xhtml bytes", len(xhtml))
# extract images
for i, img in enumerate(page.get_images(full=True)):
    xref = img[0]
    pix = fitz.Pixmap(doc, xref)
    if pix.n - pix.alpha > 3:
        pix = fitz.Pixmap(fitz.csRGB, pix)
    out = outdir / f"img_{i}.png"
    pix.save(out.as_posix())
    print("saved", out, pix.width, pix.height)
# also render full page preview
mat = fitz.Matrix(2, 2)
pix = page.get_pixmap(matrix=mat, alpha=False)
pix.save((outdir / "preview.png").as_posix())
print("preview", pix.width, pix.height)
PY

content.text: 这是学信网学历备案表，我按原表结构做成干净可读的 HTML。

VENV="/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/tmp/pdf2html/.venv"
"$VENV/bin/python" - <<'PY'
import fitz
from pathlib import Path
doc = fitz.open("/Users/mac/.cursor/projects/Users-mac-Desktop-CHcode/attachments/dd6c1cc2-e1cf-4075-ba05-0d9b371556de/10___________________.pdf")
page = doc[0]
# word positions for layout
words = page.get_text("words")
for w in words[:80]:
    print(f"{w[0]:6.1f},{w[1]:6.1f} {w[4]!r}")
print('---')
# get image placements
for block in page.get_text("dict")["blocks"]:
    if block.get("type")==1:
        print("img block", block.get("bbox"), "width", block.get("width"), "height", block.get("height"))
# also list xrefs with sizes already known
for i, img in enumerate(page.get_images(full=True)):
    print("xref", img)
PY
